# CAM output fixtures

Hand-written in the shape of typical CAM output so the readers have something
to run against. They are **not** files exported by ESPRIT, Mastercam or Fusion:
the tool tables follow the column names those setup-sheet templates commonly
print (Tool #, Dia, H, D, Flute Length, Stickout, Comment), but templates are
user-editable, so real sheets vary. Add real exports here (without customer
data) as they become available.
